items.title: Mesotherapy
items.text: This is a minimally invasive procedure by which the skin is saturated with a complex of vitamins, minerals, amino acids and other beneficial substances. Such products in cosmetology are called meso-cocktails. Their main task is to replenish the deficiency of substances in the body and launch the internal processes of renewal, regeneration and healing.
indications: Fine wrinkles and other signs of skin aging

items.title: Biorevitalization
items.text: Invasive procedure for comprehensive skin hydration and renovation using injections based on hyaluronic acid
indications: Visible dryness and dehydration of the skin
Disorders of the sebaceous glands, enlarged pores
Cell restoration after plastic surgery, resurfacing, peeling
Prevention of the negative effects of ultraviolet radiation 2 weeks before and after vacation

items.title: Bioreparation & Skin Boosters
items.text: A procedure for biological restoration of skin, which is rightfully considered a stage in the evolution of the biorevitalization procedure. Bioreparants are complex preparations based on hyaluronic acid, additionally containing peptides, amino acids, vitamins, minerals, growth factors and coenzymes. Bioreparation is the newest method of restoring youth to the skin using intradermal microinjections
indications: Wrinkles: mimic and age-related, dermal creases
Dryness and dehydration of the skin of the face, hands, neck, décolleté, body
Violation of skin texture, scars, stretch marks (stretch marks)
Dull complexion, smoker's skin, dark circles under the eyes
Preparation and rehabilitation of the skin after aggressive procedures (laser resurfacing, peelings)

items.title: Contour Plastic
items.text: One of the most popular procedures for combating signs of aging, voluminous modeling of the oval of the face with fillers without surgery. Contour plastic surgery is carried out using fillers based on biodegradable hyaluronic acid and other active components. Filler in the form of a highly purified dense gel is injected into the tissue, correcting lost volumes.
indications: Deterioration of the oval contour of the face
Lack of volume in the lip area
Imperfect chin shape and cheekbone line

items.title: Botulinum therapy
items.text: Injection of botulinum toxin to eliminate facial wrinkles and hyperhidrosis
indications: Age-related changes in the décolleté area, cords on the neck
